name: aphrody
description: Cross-platform Rust automation and reference tools exposed through one local stdio MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-platform Rust tools through local MCP
interface.longDescription: A local-only Codex plugin backed by the aphrody-mcp Rust binary. It exposes the capabilities available in the installed build for documentation, reverse-engineering triage, network inspection, voice, and bounded automation. No cloud API key is required for the local transport.
defaultPrompt: Triage a local binary with aphrody.
